description: Spreads one line of notes across polyphonic channels in turn, so each note's release can keep sounding while the next note starts, and adds a polyphonic amplifier

params.text: Sets the amplifier's overall gain, from silence to unity
Sets how many channels the notes are spread over, 1 to 5, starting at 2

inputs.text: The signal the amplifier works on, polyphonic
One line of note pitches at a volt per octave, each pitch held when its gate arrives
One line of gates, one per note; each new gate moves the next note to the next channel

outputs.text: The note pitches spread over the channels in turn, at a volt per octave, for a polyphonic oscillator
Each note's gate on its own channel, keeping the length it arrived with

notes: only one note sounds at a time, so chords do not pass through; a polyphonic oscillator and a polyphonic envelope generator are both needed for the tails to be heard
menu: Latch mode — sets when the pitch is taken: Gate rise as the gate opens, Gate fall as the gate closes, Next note not until the following gate; each mode sets its own five-sample offset
